Doubtful readings: "præviss" (printed as such), "adderetur qve" (printed with space), "veniente" (cramped, partly obscured in the scan), "Barberino Cardinali" (spacing irregular). "Ossa" printed with a long-s-like form. "Translatio ;" and "concessa ;" carry spacing as printed. Printed spellings kept, including "vit" for uit and "qve" forms, normalised only for u/v and i/j.
